correctness.rationale: The word/edge bijection and Euler-circuit normalization are explicit. Deleting q loops and q(q-1) antiparallel edges changes the de Bruijn Laplacian by -DD^T. A^3=J gives the exact zero-sum inverse; D^T D=2I, D^T A D=-2I and D^T A^2 D=B^T B reduce the matrix-tree cofactor to two known incidence eigenvalues. BEST counts q^2 reduced-degree vertices and q^3-q^2 full-degree vertices. A valid binary prefix 0100(1100)^infinity has unequal initial/terminal triple types for every length>=4, forcing an unbalanced higher-order overlap graph. Exact standalone Bareiss cofactors for q=2,3,4, exhaustive binary Euler circuits and length 4..150 witness checks passed; finite checking is not claimed to prove the infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: The previously available existence criteria do cover order-four existence and are explicitly excluded from the novelty assertion. The complete q-ary Euler-circuit enumeration after deleting all length-four tandem-square factors, and the all-higher-orders imbalance obstruction for the same forbidden family, are not implied by the inspected primary theorem or the nearby recovered claims. A general graph-counting framework is known but the specific incidence-spectrum evaluation is supplied here. Searches and material comparisons support originality with an unindexed-equivalent risk.

The fourth-order existence component follows from known results and is not an independent novelty claim.

value.rationale: This is an exact, all-alphabet enumerative invariant of the natural fixed forbidden-factor language of length-two tandem squares, not just a small census or an implicit determinant. The incidence-spectrum rank reduction turns an exponentially sized Laplacian into a two-eigenvalue evaluation. The sharp order-four/order-five universality change explains a structural obstruction for exact constrained one-pass word coverage. This combines a meaningful infinite classification with an exact integer formula useful for constrained sequence generation.
